title: Meeting prep briefs for tomorrow
summary: Researches every company you meet tomorrow and writes a one-page brief per external meeting from your Google Calendar.
trigger: Manual run; schedule it daily before your first meeting
setup: Import the template and connect Google Calendar.
Run it. It reads tomorrow's events in your calendar's time zone and skips internal meetings.
To have briefs ready by 7am, add a daily schedule to the playbook for early morning.
Optionally describe what you sell in `context` so talking points are relevant. Edit the `meeting-prep-researcher` agent to change the brief format.
notes: A meeting counts as external when at least one attendee's email domain differs from yours. Meetings with only free-mail attendees (gmail.com, outlook.com and similar) are researched by person, not company.
Research uses each company's website and a web search; it does not read your CRM.
